source_visual_observations: C and B on horizontal baseline with extension left of C; CD and BA slant upward-right and are parallel; DB diagonal; C=70°.
audit.independent_solution: CD is parallel to BA, so angle ABC = 180 - 70 = 110 degrees. BD bisects ABC, giving DBC=55 degrees. In triangle CDB, CDB=180-70-55=55 degrees, choice A.
